location: Swamp of Sorrows, in the lake in the middle
entrance: Swim to the temple in the lake, go down to the Hall of Bones and through the wide doorway to the portal.

1445.objective: Collect 20 Fetishes of Hakkar from the trolls in the temple.

4146.objective: Collect 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze with the Unloaded Zapper and bring them to Larion in Marshal's Refuge.
4146.note: The haze comes from the Deep Lurkers, Murk Worms and oozes in the temple. Two quests come first.

1475.objective: Collect 10 Atal'ai Tablets in the temple for Brohann Caskbelly.
1475.note: The end of a chain of six quests.

4143.objective: Collect 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze and bring them to Muigin in Marshal's Refuge.
4143.note: The haze comes from the Deep Lurkers, Murk Worms and oozes in the temple. Two quests come first.

1446.objective: Bring the Head of Jammal'an to the Atal'ai Exile.
1446.note: The exile stands in the spider area southwest of the Altar of Zul.

3446.objective: Find the Altar of Hakkar in the Sunken Temple.
3446.note: Two quests of Marvon Rivetseeker come first.

3447.objective: Find the secret in the circle of statues and open the chest.
3447.note: The circle of statues stands around the Altar of Hakkar.

3528.objective: Fill the Egg of Hakkar with the blood of the Hakkari Bloodkeepers and bring it to Yeh'kinya.
3528.note: The end of a chain of three quests that runs through Zul'Farrak. It calls the Avatar of Hakkar.

3373.objective: Place the Essence of Eranikus in the Essence Font in his lair.
3373.note: Starts from the essence that the Shade of Eranikus drops.
